title: THE GOOD, THE BAD, AND THE HULK-LIKE GPT: ANALYZING EMOTIONAL DECISIONS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN COOPERATION AND BARGAINING GAMES

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting specific emotional states (anger, sadness, happiness, disgust, fear) via prompt framing and evaluating their impact on the LLMs' strategic decision-making, cooperation rates, and alignment with human emotional responses in behavioral game theory settings (e.g., Dictator, Ultimatum, Prisoner's Dilemma, Battle of the Sexes).

Varying the total endowment amounts in bargaining games (e.g., testing with $1,000 vs $1,000,000) to evaluate whether the magnitude of the budget alters the baseline allocation decisions and emotional responsiveness of the LLM agents.
